scope: Bounded scan of available local DWG corpora for LOFTEDSURFACE records with nonzero DWG cross-section or guide-curve references; no drawing fixture was added.

localSourcePair.qualificationLimit: The companion DXF contains modeler binary data but no nonzero LOFTEDSURFACE cross-section or guide-vector witness. Co-commit and matching entity identity do not establish a tested native handle-vector encoding.

corpusScan.method: Run a scratch executable linked to the current libdxfrw adapter against each DWG; inspect typed DRW_LoftedSurface crossSectionHandles, guideCurveHandles, counts, and pathCurveHandle. Import failures are excluded from negative findings.

formatEvidence.observation: Autodesk's LOFTEDSURFACE table names cross-section, guide-curve, and path-curve entity data but leaves their group-code cells unspecified. Its general code table defines 310-319 as hexadecimal binary chunks and 320-329 as arbitrary handles; 330-339 are soft pointers and 340-349 hard pointers. LibreDWG's local schema maps cross_sections and guide_curves to group 310 and its writer prints handle values as unpadded hexadecimal text. The available source corpus does not establish that this mapping is accepted or semantically interpreted by a native DXF consumer.

commands: Run /tmp/loft_surface_probe once for each DWG under ~/doc/dwg and ../libredwg/test/test-data
